note: A screen, not an audit: questions worth asking and the data needed to answer them. No savings are computed; typical benefits are the cited sources' general wording.

questions.question: Is air compressor heat rejected when it could heat something?

evidence.text: equipment D-A reads "D-A AIR COMPRESSOR helper"

data_requests.item: Load hours and a nearby heat sink
where: a walkdown: space or water heating needs nearby

questions.decision_rule: Worth a look when the compressor runs long hours and a low-temperature heat user is nearby.

typical_benefit.wording: "As much as 80 to 93 percent of the electrical energy" becomes heat; recovery "anywhere from 50 to 90 percent of this".
source_titles: S11: Improving Compressed Air System Performance: A Sourcebook for Industry, 3rd ed. (DOE + Compressed Air Challenge)
